import pandas as pd

def run(inputs: dict) -> dict:
    target = inputs["target_snapshot"].copy()
    cdc = inputs["cdc_events"].copy()
    watermark = inputs["watermark"].copy()

    high_ts = watermark["high_ts"].iloc[0]

    # Step 1: filter events strictly after watermark
    cdc = cdc[cdc["event_ts"] > high_ts]

    # Step 2: pick latest event per product_id by (event_ts, event_seq)
    if not cdc.empty:
        cdc_sorted = cdc.sort_values(by=["event_ts", "event_seq"], ascending=[True, True])
        latest = cdc_sorted.groupby("product_id", as_index=False).tail(1)
    else:
        latest = cdc.copy()

    # Build lookup for latest events
    latest = latest.set_index("product_id", drop=False)

    target = target.set_index("product_id", drop=False)

    # Determine deletes and upserts
    delete_ids = set(latest.loc[latest["op"] == "D", "product_id"]) if not latest.empty else set()
    upsert_ids = set(latest.loc[latest["op"].isin(["I", "U"]), "product_id"]) if not latest.empty else set()

    # Start with carried-over products: those not touched by any surviving event
    touched_ids = set(latest["product_id"]) if not latest.empty else set()

    carried = target[~target["product_id"].isin(touched_ids)].copy()

    # Apply upserts
    upsert_rows = []
    for pid in upsert_ids:
        ev = latest.loc[pid]
        if isinstance(ev, pd.DataFrame):
            ev = ev.iloc[-1]
        upsert_rows.append({
            "product_id": pid,
            "name": ev["name"],
            "price": ev["price"],
            "last_event_ts": ev["event_ts"],
        })

    upsert_df = pd.DataFrame(upsert_rows, columns=["product_id", "name", "price", "last_event_ts"])

    # Combine carried + upserts (deletes are simply excluded)
    result = pd.concat([carried[["product_id", "name", "price", "last_event_ts"]], upsert_df], ignore_index=True)

    # Ensure correct dtypes
    result["product_id"] = result["product_id"].astype("int64")
    result["price"] = result["price"].astype("float64")
    result["last_event_ts"] = pd.to_datetime(result["last_event_ts"])

    return {"new_snapshot": result}
